buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN.

c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The furniture items to be supplied as per product specification files and should be of Reputed Bra nd and bearing following certifications:- (a) ISO9001:2015 Quality management Systems (with NACB Logo) (b) ISO14001:2015 Environmental Management System (with NACB Logo) (c) ISO45001:2018 Occupation health and Safety management System (with NACB Logo) (d) ISO50001:2018 Energy Management System (with NACB Logo) (e) Udyam Certificate / MSME in relevant category 31 in manufacturer (f) Trademark certificate. (g) GRIHA & GREEN GUARD Certificates 2. Work experience orders should be from Central / State Govt Organization / PSU within India. 3. The Bidder /company quoting the rates may be asked for plant visit in order to access the product ion capacity and evaluation of Machinery and Quality Control Equipment’s by the client /Department. 4. Undertaking should be given on letter head of OEM /Manufactured that the product /item supplie d against this tender by the contractor /Bidder is Make in India Products and up to 100% of raw material

/Man /Machinery is involved and produced within India. 5. OEM authorization certificate duly mentioning this Bid No to be submitted. 6. Manufactured and Bidder should submit the following documents / Certificate:- (a) Copy of PAN,GSTIN Certificate. (b) Company Registration. (c) Factory/Manufacturing plant license. (d) The OEM should be a member of BIFMA and the same should reflect on BIFMA website ( W WW.bifma.org) (e) AIOTA certificate. (f) Any latest test certificate for powder coating through NABL accredited lab. (g) Guarantee / warranty certificate for 24 Months from date of delivery. 7. Overall Warranty certificate of products should be 2 years against manufacturing defects on Man ufacturer/OEM letter Pad. 8. The following documents need to be submitted:- (a) Self undertaking for non blacklisting. 9. Note: EMD to be uploaded through GeM before opening of financial evaluation. Submission afte r opening of financial evaluation will not be entertained 10. Note :- All bidders are requested to go through buyer added bid specific ATC document carefully before bidding. Bidders having same IP address shall not be qualified for opening of the bid and action s hall be taken by authority as deemed fit. Bidders not fulfilling any of the terms and conditions will be rej ected / disqualified. 11. Bidder to upload certificate regarding IP address as under:- "I declare that I have utilized my own resources of electronic media for the Bid process and also I am not involved in any cartel Bidding with other Bidders" 12. Samples would be delivered first for approval of Engineer-in-Charge. Post approval of product wo uld be delivered as per changes recommended by Engineer-in-Charge. 13. The Bidder to upload Certificate regarding acceptance of "Terms and Conditions" of the Bid on Bidd er letter Head with Bid Number duly signed. 14. The products supplied by the Bidder will be inspected by the Board of Officers of the Dept at consi gnee end as per product specifications of GeM contract order. If any product is not meeting product specif ications, the product will be rejected and collected by the bidder on own expenses.

15. GSTR-06 Certificate/ Form. 16. Documents pertaining to Past performance and Experience for Primary items. 17. To upload OEM Authorization on OEM letter head for participation on instant Bid with OEM address, e-mail and phone Number with Bid Number and warranty of all products so as to contact OEMs in case of n on-response by bidder after supply before warranty period ends. 18. After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get Advance Sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit Samples for Buyer's app roval, within 15 days of award of contract. (Buyer shall, as per contract specifications, either approve the a dvance sample) or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within seven days of r eceipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modificat ions as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the deli very period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is fo und to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion ma y call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notif ying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test sh all be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to subm it an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he s hall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Con signee. 19. The documents uploaded by the bidder will be genuine and if any incorrect/ invalid documents are found at any stage, the bidder shall be solely responsible for the same and GeM contract order may be can celled by the Competent Authority. In this regard, bidder should upload a certificate with Bid No on bidder letter head. 20. PERIOD OF COMPLETION. The entire work covered under this contract shall be completed withi n a period of 90 days from the commencement of the work. The completion / delivery certificate for 90 da ys will be given in letter head pad before opening of financial evaluation. 21. The items of furniture are to be delivered at the Consignee store yard, no additional charges will be given for packaging, transportation, loading and unloading. 22. The rates quoted by the contractor in respect of the works covered under this contract shall be dee med to include for any minor details of works which are obviously and fairly intended and which may not h ave been specifically referred to in the tender documents but which are essential for the execution and co mpletion of the work in a workman like manner and sound construction. 23. In case of any difference of opinion between the consignee and the contractor to whether or not a c ertain item of work constitutes “Minor Details” of construction and cost of which is deemed to have been i ncluded in the rates quoted by the contractor the decision of the Accepting Officer in this regard shall be fi nal, conclusive and binding. 24. Quoted rates will be deemed to include all taxes, octroi, sales tax, construction labour welfare tax, and works contract tax as applicable and deduction of the same at source and the like which are to be bor ne by tenderer. Any tender not complying with this condition is liable to be treated as “NON BONAFIDE”. 25. PLACE OF DELIVERY. All the articles of furniture shall be delivered at the Store Yard of Con signee. The place of delivery is an un-restricted area. The rate quoted for all items of furniture

shall be deemed to include for supplying furniture at the mentioned station. Thorough search of all persons and transport may, however, be conducted by the military authorities at any tim e and any number of times. 26. Before giving final approval to the furniture articles, GE will get the furniture inspected by the Boar d of Officers appointed by Accepting Officer. In case the furniture is as per contract, the Board will give its recommendations for approval. Defects if any will be rectified to the entire satisfaction of the Board and t hen only the Board will recommend approval of such articles of furniture. If however, the Board recommen ds that the defects are Non- rectifiable, such item of furniture shall be replaced by the contractor at his ow n cost and replaced items of furniture shall again be inspected by the Board and give its recommendations for approval. On getting the recommendations of Board, GE will approve the furniture. 27. All the furniture items to be manufactured/supplied in the work shall be as per the standard furnitu re drgs issued by Army HQ Engineer-in-Chief, New Delhi if not otherwise specified in the tender documents . For the furniture items, for which standard drawing are not available shall be manufactured/ procured as per the sample of items kept in GE’s office or as per standard trade practice if sample item/ specifications are not available. The standard drawings to be read in conjunction with specification of items provided i n the bid document. Whenever any disparity in drawing and specifications, the specifications will superse de drawing. 28. The accepting officer can accept the tender in parts or as a whole depending upon the reasonability of quoted rates based on part wise. 30. SAMPLES OF MATERIALS. The successful tenderer shall produce within reasonable time as decided by Garrison Engineer, samples of all materials required to be incorporated in the work such as ti mber, plywood, block board, iron mongery, coir string, oxidised copper springs, plastic cane, sand pape r, French polish, paint, hard rings, steel items, mirror, cotton newar tapestry cloth, FI clamps, aluminium anodised where required. XPM, particle board, plastic laminated sheet, etc., for his approval and shall dep osit the approved samples with him suitably labeled. The samples shall become the property of the Govern ment and no extra payment shall be made to the contractor for the same. The contractor shall ensure tha t the materials incorporated for the manufacture of supplies strictly conform with the approved samples. T he contractor shall obtain written orders from GE before he places orders for procurement of proprietary materials as to the firm(s) from whom the approved materials to be procured. 31. SAMPLES TO FURNITURE. On approval of the samples of materials and within reasonable ti me there from as fixed by the Garrison Engineer, the contractor shall manufacture one sample of eac h item of schedule 'A' (for which supply order has been placed) and shall deliver the same at the MES S tore Yard of GE for the approval of the GE. Samples shall be prepared strictly in accordance with th e standard drawings and specifications using materials approved by the GE. Final finishing such as pain ting, polishing etc., shall not be carried out to the samples at the time of submission for approval. However , finishing treatment as specified shall be subsequently carried out when so ordered by the GE. Approved samples shall also be accounted for against the supplies required to be made under the contract. The sa mple items of each articles of furniture as referred above shall be accounted for payment only after delivery of complete quantity of the particular items of furniture as ordered (including deviations if any on the contractor).

32. INDIAN STANDARDS. Wherever any reference is made to any IS in the particular specification or on the drawings, it mean the edition with all amendments current at the date of issue of tender. 33. ACCEPTANCE OF ARTICLES. The contractor is required to move the furniture to the BSO STORE YARD of consignee complete in all respect for acceptance. Rejected articles shall be removed from the ya rd immediately. The contractor has to make his own arrangements for storage of the rejected articles and carry out necessary rectification of defects. 34. The articles of furniture being manufactured under this contract shall be open for inspection b y the Engineer-in-Charge/GE at the contractor's workshop (Premises) where the contractor manufactur es the articles and shall be subject to approval at such of the following stages:- (a) When the timber scantling/boarding/planking and ply wood/particle board, steel tubular pipe etc., are planned and cut and are ready for assembly i.e., before framing. (b) When the articles are manufactured complete but before application of finishing treatment. (c) When the furniture articles are finally finished and are ready to deliver. The contractor may, if h e so desires, bring the components and fabricate the furniture at site. All the articles of furniture s hall then be brought to the MES Store Yard of GE. (d) Final finishing treatment such as polishing, painting etc., specified hereinafter shall be carried out only after the untreated articles have been inspected and passed by the Garrison Engineer in writing. 35. Part payment of the furniture items will be done only after supply of 50% of contract amount. 36. Bidder has to upload all the Additional Terms and conditions alongwith scope of work d uly accepted signed and stamped. NOTE Notwithstanding the fact that the various articles of furniture have been inspected and passed by the Engineer-in-Charge at various stages as aforesaid, it shall be the responsibility of the contractor to en sure that the articles of furniture supplied, conform strictly with specifications and drawings. 37. The bidder should upload a third party (IRELASS, RITES) feasibility report as a proof of machinery insta lled in manufacturing plant of OEM :- (a) Mechanical Power Press 100MT

(b) Power Shearing M/c Minimum 8ft Length (c) Hydraulic/Manual Operative pipe Bending Machines (d) Panel saw machines (e) Post Forming machines (f) Edge Beading machines (g) Spot welding machines (h) 9 tank Antirust Treatment unit with and Conveyors for Powder Coating with ETP Plant (j) Hydraulic Power Press 150MT (k) Beam Saw (l) Bend edge Bender (m) Wet paint booth (n) Auto copy sharper (o) Four side planner. 38. The Officer will have full right to accept, reject and cancel the tender without assigning any reason. 39. In past performance and experience criteria, Bidder should also be qualifying the past pe rformance and experience criteria and not just upload OEM`s past supply orders. . 6.
